statement: Every test process scripts/run-test-files.js spawns paid for three loaders at start-up, ~1700 times per corpus. Only @tapjs/mock serves anything (t.mockImport, two files); @tapjs/typescript and @tapjs/processinfo served no .ts file, no coverage and no reader of .tap/processinfo. The runner now loads the mock plugin alone. Measured 2026-09-17 on the pass fixture, five runs each: 530 ms -> 207 ms idle start-up per process; ~9 min of process time per full corpus, 2-3 min wall at jobs=4, more under load. --no-compilation-cache stays (V8 crash class, 3bac105f1); NODE_COMPILE_CACHE is evaluated on the canary first, in canary-on-lab-node. The devDependency entries for the two loaders are a packaging change with its own proof and are left in place.

constraints.statement: t.mockImport keeps working: the runner test's fixture proves the mock plugin surface is loaded through the runner.
--no-compilation-cache and the heap bound are unchanged; a compile-cache decision needs the canary measurement first.
package.json and the lockfile are untouched in this quest.
